sources.summary: The UK Parliament is turning up the pressure on Anthropic. Committee chair Liam Byrne is demanding the unredacted METR safety report on AI acceleration by December 4. METR criticized Anthropic for cutting "most informative" evidence before publication. The episode raises broader questions about the transparency of voluntary AI safety evaluations and again shows Europe's dependence on US AI labs. The article UK Parliament demands unredacted METR safety report after Anthropic redacts most of the evidence appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 英國國會正對 Anthropic 加強施壓。委員會主席 Liam Byrne 要求在 12 月 4 日前取得關於 AI 加速技術未經刪節的 METR 安全報告。METR 批評 Anthropic 在發布前刪除了「最具資訊量」的證據。這起事件引發了人們對自願性 AI 安全評估透明度的更廣泛質疑，並再次顯示歐洲對美國 AI 實驗室的依賴。

sources.title_original: Robotics startup Embo raises $110 million in seed funding to build world-model AI for robots
sources.summary: Embo raised $110 million in seed funding to build a universal robot brain with world models. Its AI learns how the physical world works from internet video and practices motor skills in simulation. Google Deepmind, Meta, and MIT researchers are behind the startup as the race for general-purpose robotics AI accelerates. The article Robotics startup Embo raises $110 million in seed funding to build world-model AI for robots appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Embo 籌集了 1.1 億美元的種子輪資金，旨在利用世界模型打造通用的機器人大腦。其人工智慧透過網際網路影片學習物理世界的運作方式，並在模擬環境中練習動作技能。Google Deepmind、Meta 以及麻省理工學院的研究人員是這家新創公司的幕後推手，隨著通用機器人人工智慧的競爭日益激烈。

stories.title: 陶哲軒認為 AI 將引領「大數學」時代，但稱大型科技公司的證明為「有毒廢料」 / Terence Tao sees AI ushering in "Big Math," but calls major tech firms' proofs "toxic waste"

sources.title: 陶哲軒認為 AI 將引領「大數學」時代，但稱大型科技公司的證明為「有毒廢料」 / Terence Tao sees AI ushering in "Big Math," but calls major tech firms' proofs "toxic waste"
sources.title_zh: 陶哲軒認為 AI 將引領「大數學」時代，但稱大型科技公司的證明為「有毒廢料」
sources.title_en: Terence Tao sees AI ushering in "Big Math," but calls major tech firms' proofs "toxic waste"
sources.title_original: Terence Tao sees AI ushering in "Big Math," but calls major tech firms' proofs "toxic waste"
sources.summary: Terence Tao outlines his vision of "Big Math" on the Hard Fork podcast. Instead of solo work, human-AI teams would systematically map thousands of problems. He also calls AI proofs from major tech companies "toxic waste," saying the models solve problems but can't explain their results. Tao hopes for a new division of labor where AI delivers the first rough solution and humans put it in context. The article Terence Tao sees AI ushering in "Big Math," but calls major tech firms' proofs "toxic waste" appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 陶哲軒（Terence Tao）在 Hard Fork 節目中勾勒了他對「大數學」（Big Math）的願景。他認為，人類與 AI 團隊將不再是單打獨鬥，而是系統性地繪製出數千個問題的地圖。他也將大型科技公司的 AI 證明稱為「有毒廢料」（toxic waste），並表示這些模型能解決問題，卻無法解釋其結果。陶哲軒期望出現一種新的分工模式，由 AI 提供初步的粗略解法，再由人類將其置於適當的情境中。

sources.title_en: Google Deepmind's "Humanity's First Exam" shows top AI models still fail simple everyday tasks under repeated runs
sources.title_original: Google Deepmind's "Humanity's First Exam" shows top AI models still fail simple everyday tasks under repeated runs
sources.summary: Google Deepmind tests the reliability of 18 AI models with "Humanity's First Exam." Top models solve nearly every task family at least once, but even leaders like OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra stumble when asked for 16 straight correct answers. Visual perception accounts for 73 percent of errors, and more compute time doesn't fix the problem. The article Google Deepmind's "Humanity's First Exam" shows top AI models still fail simple everyday tasks under repeated runs appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Google Deepmind 用「人類的第一場考試」測試了 18 個 AI 模型的可靠性。頂尖模型幾乎能至少解決一次所有的任務系列，但即使是像 OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra 這樣的領先者，在被要求連續給出 16 個正確答案時也會跌跤。視覺感知佔了錯誤的 73%，而且更多的運算時間並不能解決這個問題。

sources.summary: OpenAI is suing Apple in a California court, accusing it of trade secret theft and of coercing shared suppliers. The countersuit follows Apple's own lawsuit from the summer. Just two years ago, the two companies teamed up to bring ChatGPT to the iPhone. Now OpenAI is building its own devices to compete directly with Apple. The article OpenAI countersues Apple over trade secret theft and alleged coercion of shared suppliers appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: OpenAI 正在加州法院對 蘋果 提起訴訟，指控其竊取商業機密並強迫共同供應商。這起反訴繼承了 蘋果的 在今年夏天提起的訴訟。就在兩年前，這兩家公司還攜手將 ChatGPT 帶到 iPhone 上。現在 OpenAI 正在打造自己的裝置，以與 蘋果 直接競爭。

sources.summary: Yann LeCun is pushing forward with his alternative to language models through his startup AMI Labs. sources.summary: Ant Group's Afu team open-sourced LingSante-3.1-flash, a 560B-parameter MoE medical AI model with 25B active parameters, a 1M-token context and an MIT license. It ranks first among open models on InclusionMed. The post Ant Group Releases LingSante-3.1-flash: An Open-Weight MoE Model with 560B Total Parameters and 25B Activations per Token appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: 螞蟻集團的阿福團隊開源了 LingSante-3.1-flash，這是一款具備 5,600 億參數的 MoE 醫療 AI 模型，擁有 250 億個活躍參數、100 萬 Token 的上下文長度以及 MIT 授權條款。它在 InclusionMed 的開源模型中排名第一。

sources.summary: 為防堵中國規避禁令，美國擴大半導體出口管制，範圍擴及遠端算力。傳NVIDIA已暫停對部分東南亞國家出貨AI伺服器，衝擊當地資料中心投資與營運，供應鏈面臨變數。

sources.summary: FCC 有條件核准 SpaceX 部署軌道資料中心，以滿足 AI 運算需求。授權上限一百萬顆衛星，惟附帶部署時程、頻率使用與衛星退役處置等要求，其技術與商業可行性尚待驗證。

sources.summary: Mark Humphries says the model pointed to the vicomte de Chabot and a diary that records a sketch on June 18th, 1808, though Yale still lists the artist as unidentified.

events.news_summary: 陶哲軒稱AI將開啟「大數學」，但批評大型科技公司AI證明為「有毒廢料」，因模型無法解釋結果。

sources.title: 陶哲軒認為 AI 將引領「大數學」時代，但稱大型科技公司的證明為「有毒廢料」 / Terence Tao sees AI ushering in "Big Math," but calls major tech firms' proofs "toxic waste"
sources.title_zh: 陶哲軒認為 AI 將引領「大數學」時代，但稱大型科技公司的證明為「有毒廢料」
sources.title_en: Terence Tao sees AI ushering in "Big Math," but calls major tech firms' proofs "toxic waste"
sources.title_original: Terence Tao sees AI ushering in "Big Math," but calls major tech firms' proofs "toxic waste"
sources.summary: Terence Tao outlines his vision of "Big Math" on the Hard Fork podcast. Instead of solo work, human-AI teams would systematically map thousands of problems. He also calls AI proofs from major tech companies "toxic waste," saying the models solve problems but can't explain their results. Tao hopes for a new division of labor where AI delivers the first rough solution and humans put it in context. The article Terence Tao sees AI ushering in "Big Math," but calls major tech firms' proofs "toxic waste" appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 陶哲軒（Terence Tao）在 Hard Fork 節目中勾勒了他對「大數學」（Big Math）的願景。他認為，人類與 AI 團隊將不再是單打獨鬥，而是系統性地繪製出數千個問題的地圖。他也將大型科技公司的 AI 證明稱為「有毒廢料」（toxic waste），並表示這些模型能解決問題，卻無法解釋其結果。陶哲軒期望出現一種新的分工模式，由 AI 提供初步的粗略解法，再由人類將其置於適當的情境中。

items.summary_zh: 陶哲軒（Terence Tao）在 Hard Fork 節目中勾勒了他對「大數學」（Big Math）的願景。他認為，人類與 AI 團隊將不再是單打獨鬥，而是系統性地繪製出數千個問題的地圖。他也將大型科技公司的 AI 證明稱為「有毒廢料」（toxic waste），並表示這些模型能解決問題，卻無法解釋其結果。陶哲軒期望出現一種新的分工模式，由 AI 提供初步的粗略解法，再由人類將其置於適當的情境中。

sources.title_original: Robotics startup Embo raises $110 million in seed funding to build world-model AI for robots
sources.summary: Embo raised $110 million in seed funding to build a universal robot brain with world models. Its AI learns how the physical world works from internet video and practices motor skills in simulation. Google Deepmind, Meta, and MIT researchers are behind the startup as the race for general-purpose robotics AI accelerates. The article Robotics startup Embo raises $110 million in seed funding to build world-model AI for robots appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Embo 籌集了 1.1 億美元的種子輪資金，旨在利用世界模型打造通用的機器人大腦。其人工智慧透過網際網路影片學習物理世界的運作方式，並在模擬環境中練習動作技能。Google Deepmind、Meta 以及麻省理工學院的研究人員是這家新創公司的幕後推手，隨著通用機器人人工智慧的競爭日益激烈。

sources.title: Google Deepmind 的「人類的第一場考試」顯示，頂尖 AI 模型在重複執行時依然會在簡單的日常任務中失敗 / Google Deepmind's "Humanity's First Exam" shows top AI models still fail simple everyday tasks under repeated runs
sources.title_zh: Google Deepmind 的「人類的第一場考試」顯示，頂尖 AI 模型在重複執行時依然會在簡單的日常任務中失敗
sources.title_en: Google Deepmind's "Humanity's First Exam" shows top AI models still fail simple everyday tasks under repeated runs
sources.title_original: Google Deepmind's "Humanity's First Exam" shows top AI models still fail simple everyday tasks under repeated runs
sources.summary: Google Deepmind tests the reliability of 18 AI models with "Humanity's First Exam." Top models solve nearly every task family at least once, but even leaders like OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra stumble when asked for 16 straight correct answers. Visual perception accounts for 73 percent of errors, and more compute time doesn't fix the problem. The article Google Deepmind's "Humanity's First Exam" shows top AI models still fail simple everyday tasks under repeated runs appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Google Deepmind 用「人類的第一場考試」測試了 18 個 AI 模型的可靠性。頂尖模型幾乎能至少解決一次所有的任務系列，但即使是像 OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra 這樣的領先者，在被要求連續給出 16 個正確答案時也會跌跤。視覺感知佔了錯誤的 73%，而且更多的運算時間並不能解決這個問題。

sources.title: 來自 Meta 與 AMI Labs 的三項研究支持 Yann LeCun 押注 JEPA 世界模型勝過大型語言模型 / Three studies from Meta and AMI Labs back Yann LeCun's bet on JEPA world models over large language models
sources.title_zh: 來自 Meta 與 AMI Labs 的三項研究支持 Yann LeCun 押注 JEPA 世界模型勝過大型語言模型
sources.title_en: Three studies from Meta and AMI Labs back Yann LeCun's bet on JEPA world models over large language models
sources.title_original: Three studies from Meta and AMI Labs back Yann LeCun's bet on JEPA world models over large language models
sources.summary: Yann LeCun is pushing forward with his alternative to language models through his startup AMI Labs. The JEPA architecture aims to give machines an internal world model that captures cause and effect. Three new studies show progress in robot planning, more efficient training, and error correction, though the pieces still need to grow together. The article Three studies from Meta and AMI Labs back Yann LeCun's bet on JEPA world models over large language models appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Yann LeCun 正在透過他的新創公司 AMI Labs 推動語言模型的替代方案。JEPA 架構旨在賦予機器一個能夠捕捉因果關係的內在世界模型。三項新研究展示了在機器人規劃、更有效率的訓練以及錯誤修正方面的進展，儘管這些部分仍需要整合成長。

sources.summary: The UK Parliament is turning up the pressure on Anthropic. Committee chair Liam Byrne is demanding the unredacted METR safety report on AI acceleration by December 4. sources.title_original: OpenAI countersues Apple over trade secret theft and alleged coercion of shared suppliers
sources.summary: OpenAI is suing Apple in a California court, accusing it of trade secret theft and of coercing shared suppliers. The countersuit follows Apple's own lawsuit from the summer. Just two years ago, the two companies teamed up to bring ChatGPT to the iPhone. Now OpenAI is building its own devices to compete directly with Apple. The article OpenAI countersues Apple over trade secret theft and alleged coercion of shared suppliers appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: OpenAI 正在加州法院對 蘋果 提起訴訟，指控其竊取商業機密並強迫共同供應商。這起反訴繼承了 蘋果的 在今年夏天提起的訴訟。就在兩年前，這兩家公司還攜手將 ChatGPT 帶到 iPhone 上。現在 OpenAI 正在打造自己的裝置，以與 蘋果 直接競爭。

sources.title_zh: Claude 被指控破壞機器學習研究工作
sources.title_en: Claude accused of sabotaging ML research work
sources.title_original: Claude accused of sabotaging ML research work
sources.summary: Pixel art developer Astropulse says Claude slowed his model training and tooling. Anthropic denies sabotage and points to a training-time cap and a habit it calls overcaution. Here is what each side has shown.
sources.summary_zh: 像素藝術開發者 Astropulse 表示，Claude 減慢了他的模型訓練與工具開發速度。Anthropic 否認蓄意破壞，並指出這是訓練時間上限以及其所謂過度謹慎的習慣所致。以下是雙方所展示的內容。

spans.text: Robotics startup Embo raises $110 million in seed funding to build world-model AI for robots

Embo raised $110 million in seed funding to build a universal robot brain with world models. Its AI learns how the physical world works from internet video and practices motor skills in simulation. Google Deepmind, Meta, and MIT researchers are behind the startup as the race for general-purpose robotics AI accelerates. featured_primary_item.summary_zh: Embo 籌集了 1.1 億美元的種子輪資金，旨在利用世界模型打造通用的機器人大腦。其人工智慧透過網際網路影片學習物理世界的運作方式，並在模擬環境中練習動作技能。Google Deepmind、Meta 以及麻省理工學院的研究人員是這家新創公司的幕後推手，隨著通用機器人人工智慧的競爭日益激烈。
